text:
maria gonzalez: hey team — need a quick decision for the chat streaming beta scope. customer asks: resume + structured deltas + clear finish reasons. i want tradeoffs and a launch checklist by EOD.

alex chen: do we have data on how many customers need resume vs just chunked deltas?

maria gonzalez: enterprise trial feedback — 3 customers explicitly asked for resume + reconnection. several mobile apps want tiny payloads (deltas) to save bandwidth.

jon park: main technical split is transport (SSE vs WS) and delta encoding (token diffs vs span updates vs full segments). each affects SDK changes and server routing.

samir rao: +1 on enumerating finish reasons. customers want deterministic signals when a reply is "complete", even if streaming continues for metadata. suggested set: DONE, INTERRUPTED, TIMEOUT, FALLBACK.

emily ng: thought: keep minimal finish reasons for v1 (DONE, INTERRUPTED) and expose telemetry for TIMEOUTs later. smaller surface reduces SDK churn.

alex chen: for transport: SSE is simpler (HTTP) and plays nicely with proxies & mobile, but no duplex. WS supports per-message binary, multiplexing, and lower latency for back-and-forth control.

jon park: important: resume semantics require server-side token/KV checkpoints and a resume token. that's orthogonal to transport but much easier to implement with WS (persistent conn) than ephemeral SSE connections.

maria gonzalez: customers prioritized resume > multiplexing. recommendation?

samir rao: propose two-tier approach: 1) v1 streaming via SSE with delta compact format + explicit finish reasons; 2) optional WS + resume in v1 for enterprise beta only behind a flag. Keeps public API simple.

alex chen: implementation notes: delta compact format example: 
```
{ "t": "delta", "p": 0, "d": "I'm go" }
{ "t": "delta", "p": 1, "d": "ing to the" }
{ "t": "finish", "reason": "DONE", "meta": {"tokens": 12} }
```
Pros: tiny payload. Cons: requires client to rehydrate partial runs.

emily ng: +1 but we need SDK helpers to reassemble and surface partials as typed objects (chat message, role, content). If we punt SDK work, many customers will copy-paste buggy logic.

maria gonzalez: launch criteria suggestion: 1) server emits finish reason for every stream, 2) delta compact schema v1 published, 3) SSE public SDKs (js, python) support streaming reassembly, 4) WS+resume behind enterprise flag, 5) doc + examples for mobile resume tradeoffs.

jon park: add: perf targets — 95th p99 token-latency < X ms for streaming handshake and delta throughput tests. and error fallback: non-streaming completion fallback path for timeouts.

samir rao: security/ops note: resume tokens must be short-lived and bound to customer session to avoid replay. add KMS tagging for audit.

alex chen: risk: dual path (SSE public + WS enterprise) increases test matrix. recommend test harness automation before enabling enterprise flag.

emily ng: what about structured output / function call integration? streaming structured events vs json blobs?

maria gonzalez: prefer event-type deltas for structured output: e.g., {"t":"func_call","name":"get_weather","argsDelta":"..."} so clients can invoke incrementally. include schema v1 in spec.

jon park: note: function-calling in mid-stream has edge cases (partial args). we should define: only deliver function_call as a final object or provide incremental args with explicit 'complete' marker.

samir rao: -> new decision: v1 structured function calls: stream arg-deltas but only signal invocation when finish reason == DONE or when function_complete event occurs. document retry semantics.

maria gonzalez: next steps: alex to draft delta schema + SSE examples, jon to prot a WS+resume design for enterprise flag, emily to own SDK reassembly APIs, samir to write security/resume token spec. i'll collect and produce a launch checklist by EOD.

alex chen: noted. i'll put a PR with schema + small test harness.

product-bot: Reminder — add RFC to /docs and tag @eng-runtime and @eng-sdk for reviews.

maria gonzalez: thanks everyone. short follow-up: if we can get a mock of mobile resume behavior (bandwidth, reconnection time) that'd help prioritize.

emily ng: i'll run a quick emulator test and post numbers this afternoon. :thumbsup:
